checklist.text: The Captain's trial for this task (his words are in the task's backlog gate record and Scope): this is build round 1 of at most 3, and you are the build worker who continues into implementation if the design gate passes. Before designing, answer in a few lines each, under a '### Before building' heading in the design: does this need doing at all and what breaks without it; what existing code, upstream or sibling repository already has it (what you checked, what you found); is there an RFC or public standard for it; is there a smaller or cheaper way to the same outcome; does it cross a boundary between components (if so write the boundary contract first and stop); where the new facts will be written once done. Then build a working throwaway probe of this task's outcome on a local branch poc/delivery-gate-s4-skips-removed-scratch in a worktree you create under the workflow checkout's .worktrees/ from origin/main, commit it locally, never push it and open no PR; run it against the real cases the task's Scope names and save what it showed in the task folder. Then write the design as what the probe showed, what it lacks to meet the Pilot bar and the task's Stop condition, and the acceptance criteria; record the branch name and commit in the design. For every acceptance criterion, run its evidence command once now on the probe and write beside it the exact command, its exit and the path of its saved output in the task folder; a criterion whose proof cannot be run now goes under a 'Not provable now' list with the reason. End the stage report with a '### Trial round 1' line giving: the premise tested and the goal check, your start and end time with the time source, the base and probe commits, the check command with its saved output and result, what blocked, and which of these fired or 'none': premise overturned; a decision only the Captain can make (scope, a criterion, a trade-off between approaches); a component boundary with no contract; production data or credentials, broad exposure, a migration, unattended recurring operation, a support duty or release and rollback ownership; a change outside the file and budget the task names

A `### Batch overlap` section naming each file the design would change and each other batch task (design-surfaces-task-dir-crash, new-work-checks-what-exists-first, delivery-gate-s4-skips-removed-scratch, observer-check-learn-only-when-listed, pr-watch-tasks-foreign-worktree) and live task of other sessions (dispatch-close-out-archives-evidence-and-removes-scratch (open PR #854), held-and-closed-tasks-leave-the-design-queue (open PR #856), adoption-asks-which-extensions, adr-required-statement, adr-silent-undo-probe, comment-check-reaches-delivery-gate, journey-canvas-hosted-poc, journey-server-host-pilot, ops-inbox-r1-setup-and-isolation, pr-review-lite-value-pilot (driven by other sessions or held; read only)) that changes the same file or check, so FO can order implementation
The words FO reads at each lifecycle moment, before and after, per root learning.md "Measure the words FO reads at each moment, not one file's size"
Acceptance criteria with reproducible evidence clauses and falsifiers, and unresolved decisions for the Captain, each with a recommendation and what gets worse under it
Run the recorded profile's design-surface check.
